bands.name: Base Camp
bands.meaning: Foundations still forming. Pick one stage and install the repeatable basics.

bands.name: Ascent
bands.meaning: Moving, but what is built and what is done daily are not pulling together.

bands.name: Ridge

bands.name: Summit
bands.meaning: Repeatable and defensible. Focus shifts to expansion and durability.

note: A few points either side of a band boundary is noise, not a difference in engine.
